action.description: One of push_main, release, deploy_prod, delete_data, spend, other. Example: push_main.

target.description: What the action touches. Example: main of the web repo.

sha.description: Optional full git sha (40 hex characters) the approval covers. Example: 9f2c1d0e8b7a6f5e4d3c2b1a0f9e8d7c6b5a4f3e.

detail.description: Optional extra context. Example: Release 1.4 after green CI.

wait_s.description: Seconds to wait for the answer. Example: 60.
